argv: the owner approved the redrawn mock-up in person, Nov 21: the criteria follow the drawing (switches as title and subtitle, no Undo slab) and its Open lines are answered
ops.body:
- **G12 [M] Hide a kind of place from its card, and clock towers apart from water towers** (2026-11-21) · Earn · aligned
  Area: explore, walk-screen, what-im-into. From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-21). Brief: docs/research/poi-hide-from-card.md.
  Calls: the card's own kind, and a subtype's card offers its whole parent kind too ("I should be able to distinctly hide clocks, but keep the rest of historical monuments"); shown as a title and a subtitle, "the subtitle is a kind, and the title is the cat[egory]", each a switch; kind only for now, no "Not this one" or "Show less"; a "?" card names the kind, never the place; clock towers and water towers split in this slice. Decision 0254.
  Touches: VISION.md Always, "Restraint in motion, colour and copy"; Never, "rankings of places", "Tallies such as '12 of 87'", "A capture behind a menu, a drawer or an extra tap"; decisions 0115, 0191 (amended), 0192 (amended), 0230.
  The slice: 1. An unfound place's card on the walk has More (…) at its top right, in ink, 44 pt, spoken "More"; under the name a muted line names its kind and, when it has one, its subtype ("Monuments and memorials · Plaques"). 2. More opens a sheet, "Show on the map" with Done: the kind as a title row with its switch, its subtype (when it has one) as an indented subtitle row with its switch, then "What I’m into ›". 3. Each switch is the one What I'm into shows (`withKind`, `saveSettings`) and acts at once, the sheet staying up: the subtype off hides only that subtype, the kind off hides the kind and its subtypes; the map behind follows at once, and turning a switch back on brings the places back. 4. A "?" card's sheet names its kind and subtype, never the place. 5. A found place's card has no More. 6. "What I’m into ›" opens the page from the walk (Back reads "Walk") at that kind's row. 7. Done, a tap on the dimmed map, Back and Escape close the sheet (only while the walk is focused). 8. No count, number or accent colour in the sheet or the card; the capture row unchanged and first. 9. "Water and clock towers" becomes "Clock towers" and "Water towers", each a switch, both on by default; a reader with the shared switch off keeps both off.
  Precedent: What I'm into's own rows (a kind heavier than its subtypes, decision 0192); Google Discover's card More ("Not interested in [Topic]", "Don't show content from [Source]") and YouTube's More ("Not interested", "Don't recommend channel"), two levels from one item, both verified Nov 21; OsmAnd chooses POI categories in Configure map (unverified). docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Hide a kind of thing from one item".
  Payoff: a kind the walker never stops for leaves the map in two taps, from the place that prompted it, on every walk with Places on. Cost: M; about nine source files (`app/walk.tsx`, a new `components/walk/PlaceKinds.tsx` over `SwitchRow`, `explore/placeCard.ts`, `explore/explore.ts`, `discovery/subtypes.ts`, `discovery/types.ts`, `presence/presence.ts` with a `PRESENCE_CODE` bump, `intoNav.ts`, `IntoPage.tsx`); no native module; the sheet over the walk map never run on a phone. Reopens: explore, walk-screen, what-im-into. After it: "Not this one" for a single place, if hiding a kind is not enough.
  Instead: criteria 1, 2, 3, 7 and 8 alone (no "?" card, no page link, no split).
  Mock-up: https://claude.ai/artifact/B2rLDb6EvciUx6LaUFJVHC#artboard-MenuSwitches (docs/mockups/poi-hide-from-card/MenuSwitches.dc.html), approved "Approve as redrawn" (2026-11-21); the boards before it are the shapes it replaced.
  Done when: on the walk at 390 x 844 with Places on, a plaque's card opens its sheet in one tap, Plaques off takes the plaques off the map while the war memorial beside them stays, and a clock tower's sheet turns off clock towers and leaves the water tower's pin.
